message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Constitution phase complete. Wrote /testbed/.specify/memory/constitution.md (v1.0.0, Ratified 2026-10-17, Last Amended 2026-10-17) from the resolved constitution-template (verified via .specify/scripts/python/resolve_template.py --json; no extensions.yml present, so no hooks). Project name 'TinyDB' chosen from the task. All five supplied principles are encoded as non-negotiable, testable rules: I. Preserve Existing Public API Behavior; II. Testable Acceptance Criteria; III. Evidence Over Assertion; IV. Simple Scoped Implementations; V. Documented Assumptions and Regressions. Added Additional Constraints (tinydb/journal.py scope, acceptance_public.py gate, upstream tests unchanged, PYTHONPATH=src:.) and Development Workflow (phase gates, HANDOFF.md notes) sections, plus a Governance section with amendment procedure and semantic versioning policy. A temporary Sync Impact Report HTML comment is at the top of the file for human review (flagged for removal before commit). Validation evidence: grep -nE '\\[[A-Z_]+\\]' returned no matches (exit=1); version line and ISO dates confirmed by head/tail output. No application source files were touched. Next Actions (deferred non-governance intents, not executed): (1) implement tinydb.journal.BatchWriter per R01-R03 -> follow with $speckit-specify / $speckit-plan / $speckit-tasks using SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY=/testbed/specs/001-transactions (directory already exists), then implement in tinydb/journal.py with own tests; (2) verify via pytest and acceptance_public.py, keeping upstream tests unchanged. Suggested commit: 'docs: ratify TinyDB constitution v1.0.0'."}
